info.name: WinX88 — Admin RBAC
info.description:
Role-Based Access System for the WinX88 Admin Panel (backend contract for `implementation_plan.md`).

**Quick start**
1. Set `baseUrl` (collection variable, default `http://localhost:3000`).
2. Run **Auth → POST admin-login** — the access token is saved automatically.
3. Every other request uses collection-level Bearer auth with that token.

**Contract**: permissions travel as `[{ section, actions: string[] }]` where `section` is a sidebar page key (`all_members`, `deposit`, `withdraw`, …) and `actions` are UI capabilities (`view`, `filter`, `edit`, `adjust_wallet`, …). Every response is wrapped in `{ success: true, data }`. If `is_super_admin` is true in the login response, the frontend grants ALL permissions and ignores `permissions[]`.

RBAC management endpoints themselves are guarded by internal `roles.*` / `admins.*` permissions — in practice SUPER_ADMIN only.

request.description:
Admin login. The response `data.admin` carries everything the frontend RBAS needs:
- `role` — role CODE string (compare against "SUPER_ADMIN")
- `role_id` / `role_name` — primary role as id + display name
- `is_super_admin` — when true, frontend grants ALL permissions and ignores `permissions[]`
- `permissions` — `[{ section, actions[] }]`, section = sidebar page key

The **Tests** tab auto-saves `data.accessToken` into the collection variable `accessToken`, so every other request works immediately after login.
